findings.title: Desktop Pause order vs DOM order
findings.detail: tools-marquee.tsx: md:order-last shows Pause after the eyebrow text at md+, while the DOM puts it first. The sibling is non-focusable, so only reading order is affected (WCAG 1.3.2, minimal). Optional: leave it as is.

findings.title: Bento AI-first tile empty at 768
findings.detail: home-768-dark-part2: the 'AI-first curriculum' tile stretches to the certification tile's height and leaves about 200px blank. Add a small visual like its siblings have, or let the row size to its content at md. This code is unchanged in this diff.
